reserveReview.rationale: ComTech states that one CGO represents one gram of allocated physical gold, held 1:1 in segregated and insured TransGuard vault accounts in the UAE. The 26 February 2026 self-signed gold-stock letter confirms 39 kg of allocated gold backing outstanding CGO. The reserve is therefore one 100% commodity-allocated slice. Bar-level or refiner-level weights are not published, but they are look-through details beneath the single allocated-commodity reserve slice rather than additional reserve slices.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer disclosure of one gram of allocated physical gold per CGO and the 26 February 2026 gold-stock letter
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No residual unknown exposure within the reserve composition: the entire reserve is allocated physical gold. Bar-level, refiner, and vault-account splits are look-through details not required for the single commodity-allocated slice.
